scope: Pure local evidence decoding, hashing and original Native arithmetic. No network, filesystem or credentials.

functions.utility:sha1bytes: function(bytes){const l=bytes.length,n=Math.ceil((l+9)/64)*64,b=new Uint8Array(n);b.set(bytes);b[l]=128;const bits=l*8;for(let i=0;i<8;i++)b[n-1-i]=Math.floor(bits/2**(8*i))&255;let h0=0x67452301,h1=0xefcdab89,h2=0x98badcfe,h3=0x10325476,h4=0xc3d2e1f0;const w=new Uint32Array(80),rot=(x,n)=>((x<<n)|(x>>>(32-n)))>>>0;for(let off=0;off<n;off+=64){for(let i=0;i<16;i++)w[i]=((b[off+4*i]<<24)|(b[off+4*i+1]<<16)|(b[off+4*i+2]<<8)|b[off+4*i+3])>>>0;for(let i=16;i<80;i++)w[i]=rot(w[i-3]^w[i-8]^w[i-14]^w[i-16],1);let a=h0,c=h2,d=h3,e=h4,bb=h1;for(let i=0;i<80;i++){let f,k;if(i<20){f=(bb&c)|(~bb&d);k=0x5a827999;}else if(i<40){f=bb^c^d;k=0x6ed9eba1;}else if(i<60){f=(bb&c)|(bb&d)|(c&d);k=0x8f1bbcdc;}else{f=bb^c^d;k=0xca62c1d6;}const t=(rot(a,5)+f+e+k+w[i])>>>0;e=d;d=c;c=rot(bb,30);bb=a;a=t;}h0=(h0+a)>>>0;h1=(h1+bb)>>>0;h2=(h2+c)>>>0;h3=(h3+d)>>>0;h4=(h4+e)>>>0;}return[h0,h1,h2,h3,h4].map(x=>x.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")).join("");}
